definitions.gloss: body wash; liquid soap for the body
definitions.explanation: Liquid soap for washing the body in the bath or shower, sold in a pump bottle. A Japanese coinage from English words; English speakers usually say "body wash" or "shower gel".

examples.japanese: ボディソープ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧。
⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧やさしいボディソープ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んでいる→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: For the children I choose a body wash that is gentle on the skin.

examples.japanese: ⟦{旅行先|りょこうさき}→旅行先：28195_ryokousaki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホテル→ホテル：01027_hoteru⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦シャンプー→シャンプー：04507_shanpuu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧ボディソープしか⟦{置|お}いていなかった→置く：01092_oku⟧。
examples.english: The hotel we stayed at only had shampoo and body wash.

notes:
Everyday vocabulary, seen on bathroom shelves and in drugstores throughout Japan.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ボディソープ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{使|つか}う→使う：00473_tsukau⟧: to use body wash
- ボディソープ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{詰|つ}め{替|か}え: body wash refill
- ⟦{泡立|あわだ}ち→泡立ち：28515_awadachi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧ボディソープ: body wash that lathers well

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{石鹸|せっけん}→石鹸：04981_sekken⟧: soap — the general word, and the usual one for a solid bar
- ⟦ハンドソープ→ハンドソープ：30564_handosoopu⟧: hand soap — for the hands, kept by the sink
- ⟦シャンプー→シャンプー：04507_shanpuu⟧: shampoo — for the hair
